column1: # The Rust API's time scales and Earth orientation on every IERS case in the tree, to the bit (Ф31.B).
# Written by crates/spacelab/tests/bridge_time_reference.rs from the IERS fixtures; the C ABI and the Python bridge must reproduce it.
# A double is the 16 hex digits of its bits; an epoch is integer nanoseconds since J2000 on its own scale. Rows, tab-separated:
#   status <first> <last step> <TAI-UTC from it> <list updated> <list expires> <continuous UTC from>, each date year month day
#   utc    <year month day hour minute second> <TAI> <TT> <TDB> | refused <kind>
#   tai    <TAI, inside int64> <year month day hour minute second> | refused <kind>
#   eop    <source> <MJD, UTC> <xp yp rad> <dUT1 LOD s> <dX dY rad> <final|predicted> <sigma xp yp rad> <sigma dUT1 s> | refused <kind>
#   ut1    <source> <year month day hour minute second> <UT1> | refused <kind>
